# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 0.x     | Yes       |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/h13/textlint-rule-rfc2606-domains/security/advisories/new).

You can expect an initial response within 7 days.
